name: Caltrops 1
description: Scatter caltrops on your tiles and tiles directly beside you for 10s.  Each trap deals minor damage, ignoring armor and flows the first 4 enemies for 4s.  The trap under you only works once you step off.

name: Frost AArrow 1
description: Fire an arrow of frost at a target, applying Suain to all monsters within 4 tiles.

name: Marksman's Focus 1
description: For 10s, Steady Aim gains 1.5x damage bonus.  Pure only.

name: Point Blank 1
description: For 6s any monster that strikes you from directly beside you will take a point blank arrow and thrown 2 tiles back.  Bosses will not be moved.

name: Shadowmeld 1
description: Shroud yourself for 5s, wiping all aggro and cleansing negative effects (Suain, Beag Suain, pramh, root, etc).  Can be cast even while under those effects.

name: Smoke Arrow 1
description: Launch an arrow applying Dall (blind) to all enemies within 4 tiles of where it lands.

name: Snare Ring 1
description: Places 4 snares around your target.  Each deals heavy damage to the first enemy to touch them, and roots them for 3s.

name: Venom Arrow 1
description: An arrow that applies Venom to all enemies within 3 tiles of where it lands.

name: Volley 1
description: Launch a volley of arrows striking every enemy within 2 tiles.  Does damage over time based on how long the enemies remain in it.
